field_principles.evidence_envelope_path: Every aggregate traces to raw prompt and response rows.
field_principles.field_principles: Every headline and gate field names the evidence boundary it protects.
field_principles.gpu_offload_authenticated: Local CUDA evidence is real and CPU fallback cannot unlock headline rows.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Repeat collapse is terminal retirement evidence.
field_principles.instances_evaluated_by_model: Denominators stay separate for each model and arm.
field_principles.maximum_parser_failure_rate: Downstream gates use the worst family.
field_principles.model_specs: Headline identity and cache path are auditable for all three mandated GGUF families.
field_principles.panel_complete: Exact extension needs a valid residual ledger.
field_principles.raw_response_replay_passed: Exact outputs remain recoverable from the ledger.
field_principles.solve_accuracy_by_model: Direct generation is separate from verification.
field_principles.solve_verify_asymmetry_supported: Headline support requires clean paired evidence.
